proposedValue: HIGH-SPEED PERFORMANCE - UHS-I Class 10 technology delivers fast read/write speeds for smooth 4K video recording and rapid photo capture.
RELIABLE STORAGE - Offers ample capacity options to securely store high-resolution photos, videos, and important files.

EASY TO USE - Plug-and-play design works seamlessly with DSLR cameras, camcorders, and other devices supporting SD cards.
